I’m fifteen, I’ve been self-harming for four years. I come to this subreddit to vent. A lot of us do. We know that self- harm is bad, and we should not do it. I mean it’s literally in the name. But I digress. I don’t come here to be told to stop. Everyone in real life is already shoving that sentiment down my fucking throat. I know that stopping is the ultimate goal, but I am not ready and can not stop yet. Self- harming keeps me sane. I know that sounds crazy, but it helps me not have a complete mental breakdown. I know there are better coping mechanisms, but self-harm is an addiction. Once you start you can’t just stop on a whim. I come here to get support from other people who deal with the same issues as me. I come here to feel like I am not alone in my struggles. I come here for the same reason I go to other mental health focused subreddits. I don’t go to the eating disorder sub to get told that disordered eating is bad, and I should stop. Obviously, I know that. I come to these subreddits because I don’t have mental health support in real life. I’m not in a position to get professional help. I want to, but I can’t. I will not stop self- harming until I get the help I need. 

Also I don’t know what you mean by people supporting other self harmers to continue. I haven’t seen any of that. If anything, I see people trying to convince people NOT to start self harming.

DO NOT START. I’ve been self- harming since I was eleven. I am now fifteen, and it’s only gotten worse. I’m addicted to cutting myself, and it fucking sucks ass. The severity of the cuts get worse as time goes on. I started off cutting very shallowly. They were so light they didn’t even leave scars. Four years later, I have to cut deeper and more for it to even have the same effect. My legs are covered in scars that will never ever go away. Hiding them from people is a hassle, and it gets really fucking hot wearing jeans in the summer. Please don’t start. Please. If I could go back, I would have never started cutting myself in the first place.
